instruction: Access and stream the video found at: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_ts/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple's advanced HLS test stream with TS format (img_bipbop_adv_example_ts). Uses the existing is_vlc_playing metric with type='url' to verify VLC is streaming the specified URL. No custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the streaming URL. The metric handles HLS streams by checking multiple XML paths for URL information.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC playing status via HTTP interface and saves status XML
Metric correctly checks both that VLC is playing (state == 'playing') and that the correct URL is being streamed
Expected value handling is correct: metric directly accesses rule['url'] when expected.type='rule' (not rule.get('rules', {}))
URL matching logic is robust with multiple fallback paths for finding URL in VLC XML, including HLS-specific handling
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both VLC playing state and URL correctness as required by instruction
Edge case handling is comprehensive: handles HLS streams, URL parsing errors, multiple XML paths for URL information
